No, the lady on the escalator cannot see the grey-haired woman wearing the pink top and white jacket before she reaches the Huawei signage.

The underside of that overhang blocks her upward line of sight toward the inner portion of the upper level, which is why she cannot see the grey-haired woman from that position.
